preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 200 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.split() if line.isdigit() and len(line) == len(line.strip())])
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 200) representing the length of string a.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n for n, a in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.split() if line.isdigit()], [line.strip() for line in stdin.split() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
preconditions.description: Each string a has exactly n characters, all lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all(len(b) == n for n, b in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.split() if line.isdigit()], [line.strip() for line in stdout.split() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string b has exactly n characters.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(a) == sorted(b) for a, b in zip([line.strip() for line in stdin.split() if not line.strip().isdigit()], [line.strip() for line in stdout.split() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
postconditions.description: The output string b is a permutation of the input string a.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(t == ''.join([b[i] for i in indices]) for indices in itertools.combinations(range(len(b)), 6) if len(set(zip('trygub', [b[i] for i in indices]))) == 6 and all(b[i] == 'trygub'[j] for i, j in zip(indices, range(6)))), for b in [line.strip() for line in stdout.split() if not line.strip().isdigit()])
postconditions.description: The output string b does not contain 'trygub' as a subsequence.
